svg.title: Defence in depth — what survives when each layer fails
svg.desc: Four independent moderation layers, light theme. Layer one, primary classifier: language-model judgement on message content; if it fails a configured fallback model takes over. Layer two, vision classifier: image moderation with its own configured fallback; if it fails image coverage degrades while text coverage is unaffected. Layer three, deterministic backstop: rules-based enforcement requiring no AI at all, so only a total system failure removes it. Layer four, outage retry queue: re-processes messages missed while classifiers were down, so gaps persist only until the next successful sweep. No numeric thresholds or calibration values are shown. Contrast computed from hex: primary text 14.84 to 1, secondary 5.74 to 1, accent 5.50 to 1. No animation. The same information is published as a table in docs/FAILURE-MODES.md.

svg.text: Four independent layers. Each one can carry the system when the layer above it fails.
